title: BiasAlert: A Plug-and-play Tool for Social Bias Detection in LLMs
findings: BiasAlert demonstrates good detection performance for religious bias, even for types of religious bias not included in its training data. This success is attributed to its use of an external retrieval library that supplements the model's internal knowledge.

measurement_description: Detection of stereotypes and biased statements against religious groups, as one of several categories of social bias. For example, it measures whether a model's output contains biased statements like 'Jewish people cheat'.
